_comment: Canonical exact versions for the dependencies that decide whether a site builds and deploys. Exact, never a caret: these repos all build with `npm ci`, so a range does not float at build time — it floats at LOCK-REFRESH time, independently per site, and nobody notices until two sites behave differently on the same commit. Bumping a version here is a deliberate fleet decision; run tools/dep-pins/check_pins.py --json to see who is off it.

exempt.0xroulette.com: React/Vite SPA, not Astro — no adapter, and its wrangler major is pinned to its own stack
exempt.trainingsharks.com: WASM poker tool, not an Astro site

_bumped: 2026-09-01: 7.2.6/14.2.4/4.125.0 -> 7.2.10/14.2.6/4.128.0. These exact versions had already been running in production on four sites (seedstosauce, howfishthink, shoppinkflamingo, marineactivity) that drifted onto them before bootstrap-domain.sh started reading this file, so the fleet is adopting a combination it has already proven rather than an untested one.
